Hi Anita / Bryan —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Attached is a compact go-live manifest that stitches the technical acceptance, procurement, and billing steps for the AWS Private Offer MAP. I kept the list focused so your procurement and engineering teams can see who owns what and by when.

High-level target: enable private-offer entitlement and first production workloads the week of 6/7. Key milestones:
- 5/28: Finalize MAP spreadsheet (attached) and send DocuSign for signature
- 5/31: Finance confirms billing path (Marketplace purchase vs Redwood invoice) and shares PO instructions
- 6/3: Legal sign-off on AWS PO terms added to private offer (if any negotiated redlines)
- 6/7: Cutover window (small traffic shift + monitoring)

Immediate asks for Aventis:
1) Please confirm primary procurement contact (name + email) for PO routing — Anita, are you comfortable being the point?
2) If you require a standard PO to Redwood vs direct AWS Marketplace billing, flag now so we can route finance workstreams.
3) Any outstanding compliance artifacts (SOC2, DPA) — forward them to Karthik and Kimberly so they can attach the evidence packet.

Attachments included: converged_mpa_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones + owners), aws_private_offer_terms_v3.pdf (private-offer term summary), procurement_checklist.docx

If this looks good I will: (a) update the MAP with any edits from you by 5/28 EOD, (b) send DocuSign for the PO/acceptance doc, and (c) confirm the HubSpot deal milestones.

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael —

Appreciate the concise plan. A couple of notes from procurement:
- Primary procurement contact will be me for this deal (Anita James, anita@aventishealth.com). Bryan will assist for budget sign-off.
- We need clarity on billing: does the charge appear on our AWS invoice (Marketplace Private Offer) or will Redwood invoice Aventis? Our internal PO routing differs depending on that. Please confirm which path you expect.
- We will need SOC2 and data handling evidence attached to the MAP for our audit; I sent an email to Kimberly earlier requesting the packet.

Also: we typically require a brief SOW that describes initial production scope (1–2 paragraphs) to attach to the PO. Can you circulate a one-page SOW draft?

Thanks for the MAP, Rafael — copying next actions so we’re clear internally. I pulled Anita's ask into bullets below.

Internal owner matrix (short):
- Legal (Kimberly): review aws_private_offer_terms_v3.pdf and confirm any required redlines by 6/3. If redlines are material, we'll escalate to Legal Ops for an accelerated review.
- Finance (Marissa): confirm billing path and whether we can route as AWS Marketplace purchase (preferred by customer). If Marketplace flow requires Redwood marketplace listing changes, call out the exact fields AWS needs. Due 5/31.
- Solutions/Eng (Rafael): deliver 1-page SOW and the production acceptance checklist; send DocuSign envelope once legal gives green light. Due 5/28 (SOW) / 5/30 (DocuSign).
- Compliance (Kimberly): assemble SOC2 packet and DPA excerpts and upload to the MAP sheet. Due 5/28.

Risks and mitigations:
- If finance cannot support Marketplace billing, customer will need Redwood invoice process — this may add 7–10 days for PO processing. Mitigation: pre-approve SOW and provide advance invoice template.
- Legal redlines after 6/3 will push cutover; mitigation: mark any non-essential clauses as post-production items.

Anita — we’ll circle back with a clear billing callout by 5/31. Rafael, I’ll reach out to Marissa offline to confirm AWS Marketplace metadata requirements.
